gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-runic: Revalia strides across the line with widely spaced, expressive letters and a g that leaves its lower curve open. Noto Sans Runic follows in a plain sans with a big x-height and curves that never close up.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Noto Sans Samaritan reads friendly and businesslike, with hefty lowercase and curves full of daylight, under Revalia's bold display lettering. Paragraphs would feel sturdy and easygoing.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Noto Sans Saurashtra keeps its capitals barely taller than the lowercase around them. Revalia is the one to spend on big, short lines where its bold, widely spaced letters can stretch out, while the plain sans does the quiet, steady work of carrying text.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-sc: Loud, loose and unmistakably display. Noto Sans SC sits beneath in sans-serif, with curves that stop short of closing, though Revalia would lose its swagger if it were shrunk down to text size.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Expressive from the first glance, Revalia stretches its letters out and leaves the g's lower curve open. Noto Sans Sharada brings the bulky lowercase and open curves, a sturdy counterweight to that bold swagger.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Approachable is the first word for the body here, though Revalia up top is the louder voice, with its bold, widely spaced letters. Noto Sans Siddham keeps a large central band in each line and an s with far-hanging ends, so a long stretch stays easy going.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: A lowercase g with an open lower curve gives Revalia its relaxed, expressive stride across the line. Noto Sans Sinhala adds a thick, dark stripe of lowercase beneath it.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo reads contemporary and screen-friendly. Revalia sits above it, bold and loosely spaced, while the plain sans below keeps a sizable x-height and wide, unclosed curves, so the two feel like a shout followed by a steady voice.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Clean and level-headed, this sans leaves e crossbars open. Beneath Revalia's bold, expressive display letters, a long stretch of it would read smoothly, with very little gap between x-height and capitals.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Revalia sets a bold, expressive tone with its open-curved g and widely separated letters across a tall band. And Noto Sans Sunuwar, a plain sans with short ascender stems, lets daylight into every curve.
